docs.contenu:
🎯 Objectives
- I can name my school subjects in English.
- I can read my timetable and say what lesson I have.

🔍 Warm-up
Chant the days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday! Now look at a timetable picture. What can you see? Books? Numbers? Days?

📘 New words & structures
Subjects: English, Arabic, French, Maths, Science, Art, Music, Sport.
School words: timetable, lesson, break, homework, classroom.
Structures:
- I have English on Monday.
- We have Maths at eight o'clock.
- My favourite subject is Art.
- We have a break at ten o'clock.

✏️ Practice examples
1. On Monday I have Arabic, Maths and English.
2. My favourite subject is Science. I love plants and animals!
3. We have a break at ten o'clock. We play in the playground.
4. On Friday I have Sport. It is fun!

🛠️ How to say it
To talk about your timetable:
1. Choose the day: On Tuesday...
2. Say the lesson: ...I have French...
3. Say the time: ...at nine o'clock.
Full sentence: On Tuesday I have French at nine o'clock.

⭐ Remember
- Days of the week start with a CAPITAL letter: Monday, Friday.
- Use ON with days: on Monday. Use AT with time: at eight o'clock.
- Subject names also start with a capital letter: English, Maths.

🔗 Try at home
Take a paper and write your timetable for one day in English. Draw a little picture for each subject. Show it to your family and say: On Monday I have Maths!

🎲 Fun corner
Timetable quiz! Work in pairs. Ask your friend: What do you have on Monday at nine o'clock? Look at the timetable and answer fast! Mini-dialogue:
- What is your favourite subject?
- It is Science. I love experiments! And you?
- I like English and Sport.

📋 Summary
School subjects include English, Arabic, French, Maths, Science, Art, Music and Sport, and they always start with a capital letter, like the days of the week. We use ON with days (on Monday) and AT with time (at eight o'clock), so a full sentence looks like On Tuesday I have French at nine o'clock. Other useful words are timetable, lesson, break and homework. We ask What is your favourite subject? and answer with It is... Write your own timetable for one day and practise saying what lesson you have and when.
